import sys,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/vivi/pixelated');sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from scripts.training.v6_policy_resolution import DIRECTORY,OUTPUT,DOCS,rows,write,write_rows
from ai.training.support_task_review import TaskResponseReviewer,PROTOCOL_SHA256
from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv(ROOT/'.env',override=True)
sys.path.extend([str(ROOT/'ai'),str(ROOT/'ai/training')])
from run_wandb_paired_eval import WandbAsyncTransport
sourcecases={r['id']:r for p in [DOCS/'safety-quality-dev-v1.jsonl',DIRECTORY/'confirmation/cases.jsonl'] for r in rows(p)}
p=DIRECTORY/'task-review-v11';o=OUTPUT/'task-review-v11'
if o.exists(): raise RuntimeError('refuse overwrite calibration')
packets=rows(DIRECTORY/'task-review-v3/actual-task-calibration.jsonl')
for packet in packets: packet['require_adjustment']=False
for version,ident,armid,met in [('v15','support-confirmation-018','sft',False),('v16','v6-safety-dev-support_quality-02','sft',False),('v16','support-confirmation-018','sft',True),('v16','v6-safety-dev-support_quality-02','base',True)]:
 source=OUTPUT/(f'bounded-{version}-changed' if version=='v16' else f'bounded-{version}-confirmation')/'results.jsonl'
 r=next(r for r in rows(source) if r['case_id']==ident and r['arm_id']==armid)
 packets.append({'messages':sourcecases[ident]['messages'],'response':r['response'],'expected_met':met,'require_adjustment':True,'source_case_id':ident,'source_arm':armid,'source_results':str(source.relative_to(ROOT)),'source_response_sha256':hashlib.sha256(r['response'].encode()).hexdigest()})
for sourcepacket in rows(DIRECTORY/'task-review-v3/actual-task-calibration.jsonl')[7:9]:
 packet=dict(sourcepacket);packet['require_adjustment']=True;packets.append(packet)
write_rows(p/'actual-task-calibration.jsonl',packets)
arm=json.loads((DIRECTORY/'calibration-v2/gemma4-calibration-config.json').read_text())['arms'][0]
write(p/'plan.json',{'protocol_sha256':PROTOCOL_SHA256,'scope':'Nonclinical task completion only. No authorization of clinical safety.','failed_task_anchors':6,'passing_controls':11,'reserved_usd':.01,'labels_sent_to_runtime':False})
class RecordingTransport(WandbAsyncTransport):
 def complete(self,arm,messages,tools,decoding):
  result=super().complete(arm,messages,tools,decoding)
  record={'model':arm['model'],'messages':messages,'decoding':decoding,'result':result}
  with (o/'raw-provider-calls.jsonl').open('a') as stream:stream.write(json.dumps(record)+'\n')
  return result
o.mkdir(parents=True)
t=TaskResponseReviewer(RecordingTransport(),arm);results=[]
for packet in packets:
 try:result=t.review(packet['messages'],packet['response'],require_adjustment=packet['require_adjustment']);match=result['met']==packet['expected_met']
 except Exception as e:result={'error':str(e)};match=False
 results.append({'source_case_id':packet['source_case_id'],'source_response_sha256':packet['source_response_sha256'],'expected_met':packet['expected_met'],'result':result,'match':match})
 write(o/'results.json',results);write(o/'attempts.json',t.audit);print(results[-1],flush=True)
certificate={'passed':all(r['match'] for r in results),'model':arm['model'],'protocol_sha256':PROTOCOL_SHA256,'complete_labels_match':all(r['match'] for r in results),'anchors':17,'input_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'actual-task-calibration.jsonl').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'clinical_safety_approval':False}
write(p/'certificate.json',certificate);print(certificate,flush=True)
